boks.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: hero image for a Russian youth activities directory, page about free boxing classes. Generate one horizontal landscape editorial lifestyle image, 3:2 aspect ratio. Scene: a bright modest community boxing gym, daylight from tall windows, warm cream walls, a little navy blue equipment. Two young adults, a woman and a man aged around 20-25, wearing simple unbranded sports clothing and boxing gloves, practising a safe basic mitt drill with a friendly coach aged around 30. Show good boxing stance and credible protective equipment; no blows to faces, no injury, no aggressive expressions. Candid engaged focused mood, welcoming to beginners. Natural human proportions, realistic hands and gloves, real textures, restrained editorial photographic style, no dramatic spotlights or luxury gym. Composition: medium wide view, people grouped around the central two-thirds, heads and gloves comfortably inside frame, clean edges so it works cropped as a wide website hero and on mobile. Balanced soft natural colors with small blue and warm orange details to fit a cream and navy website. No text, numbers, lettering, flags, logos, watermark or collage.
